entry.title: New: Resolution 722 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO ALA KAHAKAI TRAIL ASSOCIATION

Approves a grant of $132,500 to Ala Kahakai Trail Association, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to hire contractors and an intern to assist with efforts that align with the community resource management plan for the Kaunāmano, Waikapuna, and Kiolaka‘a, Ka‘ū, properties (Tax Map Keys: 9-5-011:001, 004, 005, 006, and 9-5-012:001; 9-5-007:016
